judges: Ante, Blackmun, Burbine, Certiorari, Consideration, Grant, Light, Marshall, Remand, Vacate, White, Writ

opinions.text:
Ct. Crim. App. Tex. Certio-rari denied.

Justice White, Justice Marshall, Justice Blackmun, and Justice Rehnquist would grant the petition for writ of certiorari, vacate the judgment, and remand the case for further consideration in light of Moran v. Burbine, ante, p. 412.
